paper_id: Incorporating Commonsense Knowledge into Abstractive Dialogue Summarization via Heterogeneous Graph Networks
title: Incorporating Commonsense Knowledge into Abstractive Dialogue Summarization via Heterogeneous Graph Networks
motivation: 线上多说话人对话成为重要沟通方式,需快速获取对话核心内容,但现有系统忽略常识知识整合
problem_framing: 将对话摘要任务重新定义为异构图网络中的异构节点(话语、知识、说话人)建模问题
key_insight: 异构图网络能有效融合信息并在节点和连边中包含丰富语义,从而更准确编码对话表示
method_signature: D-HGN:基于异构图Transformer编码话语-知识-说话人异构节点
evaluation_criteria: ROUGE-1/2/L F1分数+人类评估(抽象性、信息性、正确性)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: AbsRL Enhance在正确性上表现最差,因为话语抽取会破坏对话上下文连贯性
evidence_for_taste: current dialogue summarization systems ignore the exploration of commonsense knowledge
Utterances extraction will break the coherence of dialogue contexts
we claim that the heterogeneous graph network can effectively fuse information
incorporating knowledge can help our model express deeper meanings
thinking_moves: 把常识知识引入对话摘要作为异构节点而非额外输入
通过ablation study系统验证异构建模各组件贡献
零样本设置验证知识迁移泛化能力
设计message fusion解决归一化注意力忽视知识节点问题
通过tsne可视化验证学习到可区分的节点表示
